name: pad
title: Grip pad
orientation: On one flat side: a C with its tread across the layers. TPU, 95A: PLA on a kitchen scale would slip
description: A printed tread that snaps round the foot's disc, its inner ridge in the disc's groove. It takes the ground's push and bends a little under it.

grip.rule: How much the pad's bore is under the disc: TPU stretches, and it stays on

sweep.rule: Round the disc: past half way, so it snaps on and stays

ribs.rule: Cuts across the tread, each a little more edge on the ground

rib_w.rule: Each cut's width: three lines of 0.4

rib_d.rule: Each cut's depth, a third of the pad's thickness
